JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE), Subquery2 AS (SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count, ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.min_total_units_per_dept, NULL AS COURSE_NUMBER, NULL AS OFFER_COUNT, '12-unit 2022 Degree-Granting Subject' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS COURSE_LEVEL, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS min_total_units_per_dept, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.offer_count, 'Top 3 Most Frequently Offered Mathematics Course' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, COURSE_LEVEL, SCHOOL_NAME, min_total_units_per_dept, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_COUNT, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS OFFERING_DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c ON c.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND c.COURSE = tso.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte AS icte ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.COURSE_LEVEL = c.COURSE_LEVEL WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ORDER BY tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR), dept_avg AS (SELECT department, AVG(subject_count) AS avg_subject_count FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY department), subq1 AS (SELECT i.department, i.academic_year, i.subject_count, i.min_term_start_date, d.avg_subject_count, CASE WHEN i.subject_count > d.avg_subject_count * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.subject_count < d.avg_subject_count * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'WITHIN_10_PERCENT' END AS subject_count_category FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.department = d.department), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), subq2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte2 WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata2 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso2 ON ata2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.TERM_CODE WHERE ata2.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata2.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%')) SELECT s1.department, s1.academic_year, s1.subject_count, s1.min_term_start_date, s1.avg_subject_count, s1.subject_count_category, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.academic_year = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.department, s1.academic_year

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.num_unique_subjects, icte.min_total_units, mfall.avg_total_units, mfall.var_total_units, mspring.max_spring_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS mfall ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mfall.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN (SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_spring_enrollment FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND cso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND cso.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS mspring ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mspring.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptTotalEnrolled AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students, MAX(scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING) AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 20), DeptMaxEnrolled2019 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS MAX_ENROLLED_COURSE_TITLE, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry')) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dte.total_enrolled_students, dte.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, dme.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dme.MAX_ENROLLED_COURSE_TITLE, dme.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM DeptTotalEnrolled AS dte JOIN DeptMaxEnrolled2019 AS dme ON dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, inner_cte.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, inner_cte.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLED_COURSE_TITLE, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.total_enrolled_students DESC, inner_cte.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10

WITH MathFallSubjects AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON at.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.num_subjects, at.TERM_START_DATE, at.TERM_END_DATE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = at.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY i.num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10), DeptUnitsStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedResults AS (SELECT mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mfs.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mfs.num_subjects, mfs.TERM_START_DATE, mfs.TERM_END_DATE, NULL AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, 'MathFallSubjects' AS Reason FROM MathFallSubjects AS mfs UNION ALL SELECT dus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS num_subjects, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS TERM_END_DATE, dus.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dus.SCHOOL_NAME, dus.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, 'DeptUnitsStats' AS Reason FROM DeptUnitsStats AS dus) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_DESCRIPTION, num_subjects, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Reason, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH MathCourses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), Subjects2014FA AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column AS math_row_number, s14.SUBJECT_TITLE AS s14_SUBJECT_TITLE, s14.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s14.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s14.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s14.TOTAL_UNITS, s14.window_column AS s14_min_total_units_window, ROUND(mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS / NULLIF(s14.TOTAL_UNITS, 0), 2) AS Enrolled_Per_Unit FROM MathCourses AS mc JOIN Subjects2014FA AS s14 ON mc.SUBJECT_ID = s14.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY Enrolled_Per_Unit DESC

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'), cte_subject_units AS (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 9999 ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS academic_year_desc FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP), SubjectUnitsStats AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY year_sort, academic_year, dept_sort) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, academic_year_desc, dept, units_range, units_variance FROM cte_subject_units AS tbl ORDER BY year_sort, dept_sort), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10), BuildingRoomStats AS (SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.DATE_BUILT FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON ic.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY ic.area_range DESC) SELECT s.academic_year, s.academic_year_desc, s.dept, s.units_range, s.units_variance, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.area_range, b.area_variance, b.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.DATE_BUILT FROM SubjectUnitsStats AS s CROSS JOIN BuildingRoomStats AS b ORDER BY s.academic_year, s.dept, b.area_range DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptTotalEnrolled AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students, MAX(scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING) AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 20), DeptMaxEnrolled2019 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS MAX_ENROLLED_COURSE_TITLE, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry')) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dte.total_enrolled_students, dte.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, dme.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dme.MAX_ENROLLED_COURSE_TITLE, dme.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM DeptTotalEnrolled AS dte JOIN DeptMaxEnrolled2019 AS dme ON dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, inner_cte.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, inner_cte.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLED_COURSE_TITLE, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.total_enrolled_students DESC, inner_cte.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10

WHERE at.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE '%Fall%'
  AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY subject_count DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
    at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
    at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
  AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y'
GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY num_subjects DESC
LIMIT 10;
